title: Eventual agreement of a single pair of local unit lifts
statement: Let X be a scheme [def-pc-scheme], J a small cofiltered category [def-weil-pbc-category-colimit], and D:J→X_et a diagram [def-weil-pbc-etale-site] of affine schemes [def-weil-pbc-scheme-conventions] openly immersed in X [def-weil-open-immersion]. Let c be a limiting cone of its underlying scheme diagram and p:c.pt→X its compatible structure map. Let H be left adjoint to p_* [def-weil-pbc-direct-image], with adjunction hH, F an abelian etale sheaf [def-weil-pbc-abelian-etale-sheaves], and t a terminal section of H(F). Fix j, affine etale objects V,W with arrows v:V→D(j), w:W→D(j), sections s∈F(V), r∈F(W), and arrows πV:p*V→T, πW:p*W→T to T=(c.pt,id), where p* is actual base change [def-pc-fibre-product]. Assume that the unit images of s and r are the restrictions of t along πV and πW. There exist k and f:k→j such that for every etale X-object U, arrows a:U→V, a′:U→W and q:U→D(k) satisfying a v=q D(f) and a′ w=q D(f), F(a)(s)=F(a′)(r). No covering hypotheses or covering conclusion are involved.

source.place: Equality-open lemma; combined with 03Q6 proof (2), for one affine overlap and a cofiltered tail.

proof.text: Form O=V times_D(j) W as an etale X-object, with projections b and b'. It is affine because V,W,D(j) are affine. Put z=F(b)(s)-F(b')(r). Unit naturality identifies its two unit terms with restrictions of t along p*b followed by piV and p*b' followed by piW. These arrows to the identity etale object agree: their underlying maps are both the structural map. Therefore the unit of z is zero. Apply the unit-zero-neighbourhood theorem to obtain an open A in O containing the image of O times_X c.pt, with z zero on A.

Use baseChangeDiagram and baseChangeCone for O -> D(j), on Over j. isLimitBaseChangeCone proves the cone is limiting. All stages are affine, hence compact, and all transitions affine. The limit projection into O factors through O times_X c.pt, by hp and the pullback universal property, so its image lies in A. At the identity tail object, apply exists_map_eq_top to the preimage of A. baseChangeDiagram_map_fst gives k and f:k -> j with image of O times_D(j) D(k) -> O contained in A.

For every U,a,a',q in the conclusion, pullback.lift gives d:U -> O from the two compatibility equations. A second pullback.lift factors d through O times_D(j) D(k); hence its image is in A. IsOpenImmersion.lift factors it through A. Restrict the zero section z|A along that factor, use map_sub and presheaf functoriality, and conclude F(a)(s)=F(a')(r) by sub_eq_zero.

proof_origin.place: Equality-open argument combined with 03Q6 (2), proved via whole-base-change unit vanishing, geometric stalks, and baseChangeCone on the cofiltered tail.

lean.statement:
theorem affineOpenSections_pair_eventual_agreement
    {X : Scheme.{u + 1}} {J : Type (u + 1)} [SmallCategory J] [IsCofiltered J]
    (D : J ⥤ X.Etale)
    [∀ j, IsAffine (D.obj j).left] [∀ j, IsOpenImmersion (D.obj j).hom]
    (c : Cone (D ⋙ Scheme.Etale.forget X ⋙ Over.forget X))
    (p : c.pt ⟶ X) (hp : ∀ j, c.π.app j ≫ (D.obj j).hom = p)
    (hc : IsLimit c)
    (H : Sheaf X.smallEtaleTopology AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1} ⥤
      Sheaf c.pt.smallEtaleTopology AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1})
    (hH : H ⊣ p.Etale.sheafPushforwardContinuous
      AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1} X.smallEtaleTopology c.pt.smallEtaleTopology)
    (F : Sheaf X.smallEtaleTopology AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1})
    (t : (H.obj F).obj.obj (op (Scheme.Etale.mk (𝟙 c.pt))))
    (j : J) (V W : X.Etale) (v : V ⟶ D.obj j) (w : W ⟶ D.obj j)
    (s : F.obj.obj (op V)) (r : F.obj.obj (op W))
    (πV : p.Etale.obj V ⟶ Scheme.Etale.mk (𝟙 c.pt))
    (πW : p.Etale.obj W ⟶ Scheme.Etale.mk (𝟙 c.pt))
    (hV : IsAffine V.left) (hW : IsAffine W.left)
    (hs : (H.obj F).obj.map πV.op t = (hH.unit.app F).hom.app (op V) s)
    (hr : (H.obj F).obj.map πW.op t = (hH.unit.app F).hom.app (op W) r) :
    ∃ (k : J) (f : k ⟶ j),
      ∀ (U : X.Etale) (a : U ⟶ V) (a' : U ⟶ W) (q : U ⟶ D.obj k),
        a ≫ v = q ≫ D.map f → a' ≫ w = q ≫ D.map f →
        F.obj.map a.op s = F.obj.map a'.op r
